name: Explicit phrase-to-map witnesses for scene referent binding
additional_supervision: ScanEnts3D phrase-to-instance correspondences, NR3D and official ScanNet instances; only original 22 training rooms
input: same frozen native descriptors, scene geometry, full query tokens; all supported regional candidates
architecture: language-to-scene attention feeds grounded visual/geometric witnesses back to candidate resolution
controlled_difference: grounded adds equally weighted per-query mean phrase alignment CE; ungrounded uses final referent CE alone
alignment_target: equal instance mass, each instance normalized decoded scope IoU^4 over all regions; unavailable support omitted from auxiliary supervision only
training_budget: same named 1377 unique eligible records, resampled to1592 presentations/epoch; 12 epochs, seed20261005, batch8/microbatch1
checkpoint_selection: complete207-query calibration scene-macro actual set IoU, including zero-correction epoch0
bounded_search: two fixed fits, no parameter revision
diagnostics: held-out phrase binding accuracy/soft set IoU, query-mean correction intervention, removal of query-specific scene witnesses
scope: identity only; unchanged complete-instance decoder, native teacher coordinates, geometry and all nontext modalities
query_permissions: map only; no phrase labels, source RGB/depth or cross-query target identity
status: completed; failed declared development gate; no benchmark execution or default promotion
native_contextual_token_diagnosis: frozen text pooled-output head applied at arbitrary token positions is a diagnostic, not a valid native phrase representation
